name: Odin 2
author: 3dthc
summary: Odin 2 synthesizer ported to standalone Akai MPC devices as a native VST2 plugin. Features Odin's original engine, 261 factory patches, touchscreen pages, automatic voice management and a CPU meter. Tested on an Akai MPC Live II; unofficial port. Also a VST3 for Mac and Windows and an Audio Unit for Mac.
